instruction: Configure LibreOffice Writer to use dark mode theme.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling dark mode theme in LibreOffice Writer. Evaluator checks registrymodifications.xcu for ApplicationAppearance=1 (dark mode enabled). ApplicationAppearance controls the application's color scheme. Similar complexity to original - both involve system configuration changes.

llm_judge_reasons: CORRECT: Evaluator checks ApplicationAppearance setting which is the correct configuration for LibreOffice dark mode

SEMANTIC CORRECTNESS: The expected pattern '<item oor:path="/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Misc"><prop oor:name="ApplicationAppearance" oor:op="fuse"><value>1</value>' correctly verifies that ApplicationAppearance is set to 1 (dark mode enabled)
COMPLETE COVERAGE: The instruction 'Configure LibreOffice Writer to use dark mode theme' is fully verified by checking the ApplicationAppearance setting
PROPER POSTCONFIG: Uses cat to dump the registrymodifications.xcu file after task completion, making the configuration state accessible for verification
CORRECT GETTER/METRIC FLOW: get_cache_file retrieves the dumped config file, check_list searches for the expected XML pattern, returns 1.0 if dark mode is enabled
The evaluator can correctly verify whether dark mode is actually enabled in LibreOffice Writer
